name: Los Tres Gorditos
tagline: Carnitas nachos, tacos and burgers on Main Street in Calvert.
about: Los Tres Gorditos at 403 Main St in Calvert serves Mexican food and burgers Monday through Saturday.
Regulars order the carnitas nachos, steak and chicken tacos, and the double and mushroom Swiss burgers. Dine in, take out, or pick up curbside.
